label: Inert-emptiness controls checked (inference)
rule: Explicit two-world interpretations with natural-number times, checked by case analysis
meaning: Omitting inert emptiness, the possible contingent-free past, or presence-to-existence each permits failure of the conclusion while the frame conditions and the other two premises hold; a fourth interpretation jointly satisfies all premises with a contingent individual and a necessary one, so the bundle is nonvacuous. Omission of the two frame conditions is not tested here. Model claims concern these finite interpretations only.
